frozen_def: def WellSeparatedSet (A : Set ℝ) : Prop := (A ⊆ (Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ))) ∧ Set.Infinite A ∧ Set.Countable A ∧ (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x ≠ y → (∀ k ≥ (1 : ℕ), 1 ≤ |k * x - y|))
campaign_def: def WellSeparatedSet (A : Set ℝ) : Prop := (A ⊆ (Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ))) ∧ Set.Infinite A ∧ Set.Countable A ∧ (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x ≠ y → (∀ k ≥ (1 : ℕ), 1 ≤ |k * x - y|))
